title: Concrete Volume & Bag Calculator
fn: Works out concrete volume for slabs, footings, columns and steps, then the exact bag or ready-mix order.
logic: Volume per shape: slab L×W×D; footing L×W×D per run; column pi*r^2*h; steps summed as stacked slabs. Convert ft3<->yd3<->m3. Bags: 60lb yields 0.45 ft3, 80lb 0.60 ft3, 40lb 0.30 ft3 - round UP. Waste factor slider 0-15% default 10%. Ready-mix rounds up to 0.25 yd3. Show cost from a per-bag and per-yard price input. Multiple pours in one job, totalled.
out: localStorage job list; print-ready order sheet; CSV export

title: Paint Coverage Estimator
fn: Room-by-room paint quantities including doors, windows, ceilings and number of coats.
logic: Wall area = perimeter x height; subtract openings (door default 21 ft2, window 15 ft2, editable). Ceiling = L×W. Coverage default 350 ft2/US gal (37 ft2/L metric), editable per product. Cans = ceil(area x coats / coverage). Separate primer pass. Per-room breakdown plus whole-job total; paint cost per can gives job cost.
out: localStorage projects; printable spec sheet; CSV

title: Roofing Squares & Material Take-off
fn: Roof area from footprint and pitch, converted to squares with shingles, underlay, ridge and starter.
logic: Pitch multiplier = sqrt(1+(rise/12)^2). Roof area = footprint x multiplier. Squares = area/100. Bundles = squares x 3 (3-tab). Underlay rolls at 4 squares/roll (15lb) or 10 (synthetic). Ridge cap LF, starter strip LF, drip edge = eave+rake LF. Nails 320/square. Waste 10% simple, 15% cut-up. Multiple roof planes.
out: localStorage; printable material list; CSV

title: Tile & Flooring Take-off
fn: Boxes of tile or flooring for any set of rooms, with waste, layout pattern and grout.
logic: Area per room L×W minus cut-outs. Waste by pattern: straight 10%, diagonal 15%, herringbone 20%. Boxes = ceil(area x (1+waste) / box coverage). Grout volume approx = (tileL+tileW)/(tileL x tileW) x jointWidth x tileDepth x area x 1.5 (lb). Adhesive coverage per bag input. Underlay rolls. Per-room and total.
out: localStorage; printable order list; CSV

title: Lumber Cut Optimiser
fn: Given a cut list and stock lengths, works out the fewest boards and the exact cut plan.
logic: First-fit-decreasing bin packing over stock lengths, accounting for saw kerf (default 3mm/0.125in) per cut. Support multiple stock lengths with prices - choose the cheapest combination, not just the fewest boards. Show each stock piece with its cuts laid out to scale and the offcut remaining. Report total waste % and material cost.
out: localStorage cut lists; printable cut plan with scale diagram; CSV

title: Drywall Sheets, Mud & Tape
fn: Sheet count, screws, joint compound and tape for a set of rooms.
logic: Wall+ceiling area minus openings. Sheets = ceil(area/sheet area) with 4x8=32, 4x10=40, 4x12=48 ft2. Waste 10-15%. Screws approx 32/sheet. Tape LF approx 1.4 x sheet perimeter joints. Compound: 0.053 gal per ft2 for 3 coats (approx 4.5 gal per 1000 ft2). Corner bead LF from internal/external corner counts.
out: localStorage; printable list; CSV

title: Fence Post & Panel Layout
fn: Posts, panels, rails and concrete for a fence run, including gates and corners.
logic: Posts = ceil(run/spacing)+1 per straight section; add one per corner and two per gate. Panels = posts-1 per section. Rails = panels x rails-per-panel. Post hole volume = pi*r^2*depth, concrete bags from that (see bag yields). Depth rule of thumb = 1/3 post height. Pickets = run/(picket width+gap). Handles multiple sections with different lengths.
out: localStorage; printable layout + material list; CSV

title: Excavation Cut & Fill
fn: Excavation volume, truck loads and spoil allowing for bulking.
logic: Volume = L×W×avg depth; trapezoidal for battered sides. Bulking factors: sand 1.10, gravel 1.12, clay 1.30, rock 1.50 (editable). Loose volume = bank volume x factor. Truck loads = ceil(loose/truck capacity). Compaction for fill: compacted = loose/shrink factor. Cost from per-load haul rate and per-hour machine rate.
out: localStorage; printable sheet; CSV

title: HVAC Rough Load Sizing
fn: Ballpark heating and cooling load for a dwelling from area, climate, insulation and glazing.
logic: Rule-of-thumb method, clearly labelled as preliminary not a Manual J. Base BTU/ft2 by climate zone (zone1 30, z2 35, z3 40, z4 45, z5 50, z6 55, z7 60). Adjust: poor insulation +25%, good -15%; single glazing +15%, triple -10%; each occupant over 2 +600 BTU; kitchen +4000. Tons = BTU/12000. Show both heating and cooling. Prominent notice that a full Manual J is required for permit or equipment selection.
out: localStorage; printable summary with the disclaimer; CSV

title: Conduit Fill & Wire Ampacity
fn: Checks conduit fill percentage and looks up conductor ampacity with derating.
logic: NEC Chapter 9 Table 1 fill limits: 1 conductor 53%, 2 conductors 31%, 3 or more 40%. Conductor areas from Chapter 9 Table 5 for THHN/THWN 14AWG-500kcmil. Conduit internal areas for EMT, IMC, RMC, PVC40 trade sizes. Ampacity from Table 310.16 at 60/75/90C. Derate for more than 3 current-carrying conductors (4-6: 80%, 7-9: 70%, 10-20: 50%) and ambient temperature. Flag a PASS/FAIL on fill. Notice that the authority having jurisdiction governs.
out: localStorage saved runs; printable calculation record; CSV

title: Plumbing Pipe Sizing
fn: Water supply pipe size from fixture units, and drain size from drainage fixture units.
logic: Water supply fixture units (WSFU) per fixture type from a standard table (water closet flush tank 2.2, lavatory 0.7, shower 1.4, kitchen sink 1.4, dishwasher 1.4, hose bib 2.5). Total WSFU converted to gpm via Hunter's curve approximation. Pipe size from gpm and velocity limit (8 ft/s cold, 5 ft/s hot). Drainage fixture units (DFU) with max DFU per drain size (1.5in 3, 2in 6, 3in 20, 4in 160). Vent sizing. Notice that local code governs.
out: localStorage; printable sizing record; CSV

title: Stair Rise & Run Calculator
fn: Riser and tread dimensions from a total rise, checked against code limits, with a scale drawing.
logic: Risers = round(totalRise/target riser, default 7in/175mm). Actual riser = totalRise/risers. Treads = risers-1. Total run = treads x tread depth. Checks: riser 4-7.75in, tread min 10in, riser+tread 17-18in, 2xriser+tread 24-25in, headroom min 6ft8in, all flagged PASS/FAIL. Stringer length = sqrt(rise^2+run^2). Draws the stair to scale in SVG with dimensions.
out: localStorage; printable drawing + cut list; CSV

title: Freight Class & Density Calculator
fn: Density-based NMFC freight class for LTL shipments, handling multiple pallets.
logic: Cubic feet = (L x W x H in inches)/1728 per handling unit. Density = weight/cubic feet. NMFC density classes: >=50 class 50; 35-50 c55; 30-35 c60; 22.5-30 c65; 15-22.5 c70; 13.5-15 c77.5; 12-13.5 c85; 10.5-12 c92.5; 9-10.5 c100; 8-9 c110; 7-8 c125; 6-7 c150; 5-6 c175; 4-5 c200; 3-4 c250; 2-3 c300; 1-2 c400; <1 c500. Multiple units summed for total weight, cube and overall density. Pallet presets 48x40.
out: localStorage shipment list; printable BOL-ready summary; CSV

title: Truckload Profit Calculator
fn: Whether a load is worth taking: revenue against fuel, driver pay, deadhead and fixed cost per mile.
logic: Total miles = loaded + deadhead. Revenue from flat rate or rate/mile. Fuel cost = total miles / MPG x fuel price. Driver pay = loaded miles x cents-per-mile, or percentage of revenue, or hourly. Fixed cost per mile input (truck payment, insurance, maintenance). Net = revenue - fuel - driver - fixed - tolls - accessorials. Show revenue per loaded mile, net per mile, and margin %. Break-even rate needed. Compare up to three loads side by side.
out: localStorage load history; printable decision sheet; CSV

title: Pallet & Trailer Load Planner
fn: How many cases fit a pallet and how many pallets fit the trailer, drawn to scale.
logic: Cases per layer by trying both orientations on the pallet footprint (48x40 default, editable) - report the better fit. Layers = floor(max stack height / case height), respecting max stack weight. Trailer positions: 53ft dry van fits 26 pallets straight or 30 turned (pinwheel), 48ft 24, 26ft box 12 - compute from trailer internal dims rather than hardcoding. Check total weight against 45,000 lb payload. Draw the pallet layer pattern and the trailer floor plan in SVG.
out: localStorage; printable load plan with diagrams; CSV

title: Hours of Service Planner
fn: Plans a driver's day against US HOS limits and shows when they run out of hours.
logic: Property-carrying rules: 11-hour driving limit, 14-hour on-duty window from first on-duty, 30-minute break required after 8 cumulative driving hours, 10 consecutive hours off to reset, 60/7 or 70/8 cycle with optional 34-hour restart. Sleeper-berth split 8/2 or 7/3. User enters duty events; the tool draws the day on a timeline and flags each violation with the specific rule. Shows time remaining on each clock. Prominent notice that the ELD record is the legal record.
out: localStorage duty logs; printable day sheet; CSV

title: Fuel Surcharge Calculator
fn: Fuel surcharge from a DOE index price, base peg and MPG, per load or per mile.
logic: Surcharge per mile = (current fuel price - base peg price) / MPG. Total = per-mile x miles. Alternative percentage-of-linehaul method with a step table (price band -> percent). Both methods side by side. Editable peg (default $1.25) and MPG (default 6.0). Effective date and index source recorded on the output for billing evidence.
out: localStorage rate tables; printable surcharge schedule; CSV

title: Detention & Accessorial Biller
fn: Calculates detention, layover, TONU and accessorial charges into an invoice-ready line list.
logic: Detention = billable hours beyond free time (default 2 hours), rounded per the rule chosen (exact, 15-min, 30-min, hourly), x hourly rate, capped at a daily max if set. Layover flat per night. TONU flat. Lumper, driver assist, reconsignment, redelivery, stop-off (per extra stop), tarping as configurable line items. Arrival/departure times entered as timestamps, hours computed. Produces a chargeable summary with the supporting timestamps for dispute evidence.
out: localStorage; printable accessorial invoice; CSV

title: Dimensional Weight Calculator
fn: Billable weight across carriers, comparing actual against dimensional weight.
logic: Dim weight = (L x W x H) / divisor. Divisors: UPS/FedEx US domestic 139 (in3/lb), international 139, USPS 166, DHL 139 or 5000 (cm3/kg), freight 250. Billable = greater of actual and dim, rounded up to the next whole pound/kg. Compare all carriers in one table and highlight the cheapest billable weight. Multi-package shipments totalled. Metric and imperial.
out: localStorage; printable comparison; CSV

title: Rate Confirmation Generator
fn: Produces a carrier rate confirmation from load details, ready to send and sign.
logic: Fields: broker/shipper details, carrier name MC/DOT, load number, equipment, commodity, weight, pickup and delivery with addresses, dates and appointment windows, stop sequence, linehaul, fuel surcharge, accessorials, total, payment terms, required documents, and standard carrier obligations text. Computes the total from the line items. Generates a sequential confirmation number. Signature blocks for both parties.
out: localStorage load records; print-to-PDF confirmation; JSON export

title: Driver Settlement Statement
fn: Weekly driver pay statement covering per-mile, percentage or hourly pay with deductions.
logic: Pay methods: cents per loaded mile, cents per all miles, percentage of linehaul, hourly, or flat per load - mixed across loads in one week. Add accessorial pay (stop pay, detention share, tarp). Deductions: escrow, insurance, advances/comdata, fuel, ELD, occupational accident, cash advance fees. Reimbursements added after deductions. Gross, deductions, net. Year-to-date carried in storage. Per-load detail lines.
out: localStorage driver records; printable settlement; CSV

title: IFTA Quarterly Worksheet
fn: Quarterly IFTA fuel tax worksheet by jurisdiction with net tax owed or credit.
logic: Per jurisdiction: taxable miles and tax-paid gallons purchased. Fleet MPG = total miles / total gallons. Taxable gallons per jurisdiction = miles / fleet MPG. Net taxable gallons = taxable - purchased. Tax due = net x jurisdiction rate (user-entered per quarter, since rates change - with a note to pull current rates from the IFTA rate sheet). Totals across jurisdictions with net due or credit. Interest field. Supports multiple trucks summed to a fleet return.
out: localStorage quarters; printable worksheet matching the return layout; CSV

title: Container CBM & Stuffing Calculator
fn: Cubic metres, chargeable weight and how many cartons fit a sea container.
logic: CBM = L x W x H (m) per carton x quantity. Container internal volumes: 20GP 33.2 cbm / 28,200 kg payload, 40GP 67.7 / 26,700, 40HC 76.4 / 26,460, 45HC 86.1 / 27,700. Utilisation % by volume and by weight - report which one limits the load. Cartons per container by simple 3-axis fit with the best of six orientations. LCL chargeable weight = greater of CBM and weight/1000 (1 cbm = 1 tonne rule).
out: localStorage; printable stuffing plan; CSV

title: Lane Rate Comparison Sheet
fn: Compares carrier quotes on a lane, all-in, and tracks what you actually paid over time.
logic: Per quote: linehaul, fuel surcharge, accessorials, transit days, equipment. All-in total and rate per mile computed. Ranks by total and by rate/mile. Records the awarded carrier and actual invoiced amount afterwards so variance from quote is visible. Rolling history per lane shows rate trend as a small line chart. Origin/destination stored as city/state pairs with mileage entered.
out: localStorage lane history; printable comparison; CSV

title: Invoice Generator
fn: Professional invoices with line items, tax, discounts and payment terms - print or PDF.
logic: Line items with quantity, unit price, per-line discount and tax rate. Subtotal, discount, tax (multiple rates supported and summarised separately), shipping, total. Deposit/part payment reduces balance due. Sequential invoice numbering that increments and persists. Due date from terms (net 7/14/30/60, due on receipt, custom). Business details and logo (data-URI upload) saved once and reused. Client address book. Currency and locale-aware formatting.
out: localStorage clients + invoice history; print stylesheet for PDF; CSV and JSON export

title: Quote & Estimate Builder
fn: Quotes with optional line items, tiered pricing and an acceptance block.
logic: Line items with quantity, rate, and an optional flag so the client can include or exclude them - the total updates live as options are toggled. Good/better/best tiers side by side. Validity period with expiry date. Terms and scope text blocks. Deposit percentage required to accept. Converts to an invoice, carrying every field across. Sequential quote numbering.
out: localStorage; print/PDF; converts to the invoice format; JSON

title: Purchase Order Generator
fn: Purchase orders with supplier details, delivery instructions and approval routing.
logic: Line items with SKU, description, quantity, unit cost, tax. Ship-to distinct from bill-to. Required-by date. PO number sequence. Approval block with name/date and a budget code field. Running total against an optional budget limit with a warning when exceeded. Supplier address book. Partial receipt tracking - mark quantities received and see outstanding.
out: localStorage suppliers + PO history; print/PDF; CSV

title: Receipt Generator
fn: Payment receipts, including part payments against an invoice.
logic: Records amount received, method (cash, card, transfer, cheque), date, and what it was for. Links to an invoice number and shows the remaining balance after this payment. Sequential receipt numbers. Thermal-width print layout (80mm) as well as A4/Letter. Handles overpayment and refund receipts (negative).
out: localStorage; dual print layouts; CSV

title: Delivery Note & Packing Slip
fn: Packing slips with quantities ordered against shipped, and a signature block.
logic: Line items showing ordered, shipped and back-ordered quantities computed from the first two. Package count and weights. Carrier and tracking number. Special handling flags. Recipient signature and print-name block with date/time. Links to an order or invoice number. Deliberately omits prices (the standard packing-slip convention) with a toggle to include them.
out: localStorage; print/PDF; CSV

title: Statement of Account
fn: Customer statement showing invoices, payments and an ageing summary.
logic: Transaction list per customer: invoices as debits, payments and credit notes as credits, with a running balance. Ageing buckets computed from due dates: current, 1-30, 31-60, 61-90, 90+ days, each totalled. Statement period selectable. Opening and closing balance. Overdue total highlighted with the oldest invoice age.
out: localStorage ledger; print/PDF statement; CSV

title: Credit Note Generator
fn: Credit notes against an invoice, full or partial, with the reason recorded.
logic: Select an original invoice number and credit whole lines or partial quantities/amounts. Tax reversed proportionally at the original rates. Reason code (return, damage, pricing error, goodwill, cancellation) required. Sequential credit note numbering separate from invoices. Shows the invoice's remaining balance after crediting.
out: localStorage; print/PDF; CSV

title: Expense Claim Form
fn: Employee expense claims by category with receipt notes, tax and approval.
logic: Line per expense: date, category, description, net, tax, gross - with tax computed either way. Categories configurable with per-category limits that warn when exceeded. Mileage lines calculated from distance x rate feeding the same total. Per-diem lines. Claim total by category and grand total. Submitted-by and approved-by blocks with dates. Flags claims over a threshold for extra approval.
out: localStorage; print/PDF; CSV

title: Mileage Log & Claim
fn: Journey-by-journey business mileage with automatic reimbursement at tiered rates.
logic: Per journey: date, from, to, purpose, odometer start/end (distance auto-computed) or direct distance, and business/personal flag. Tiered rates - the UK 45p first 10,000 miles then 25p, and the US IRS single rate - both selectable, with the tier boundary applied automatically across the year. Running annual total shows which tier you are in. Vehicle registration and multiple vehicles. Monthly and annual summaries.
out: localStorage full-year log; print/PDF claim; CSV

title: Timesheet & Hours Calculator
fn: Weekly timesheets with breaks, overtime bands and pay computed.
logic: Per day: start, end, unpaid break minutes - hours computed handling shifts crossing midnight. Weekly total. Overtime rules: over 8/day, over 40/week, or both without double-counting; time-and-a-half and double-time bands configurable. Pay = regular x rate + OT x multipliers. Multiple employees in one sheet. Rounds to the nearest configurable increment (1, 5, 6, 15 minutes).
out: localStorage; print/PDF; CSV for payroll import

title: Petty Cash Ledger
fn: Petty cash tin reconciliation with float, receipts and a variance check.
logic: Opening float, each disbursement with date/payee/category/amount/voucher number, and top-ups. Running balance. Physical count entry by denomination (notes and coins) totalled and compared to the book balance - variance shown and flagged. Imprest system: top-up needed = float - current balance. Category totals for posting to accounts. Period close locks the period and carries the balance forward.
out: localStorage; print/PDF reconciliation; CSV

title: Double-Entry Ledger
fn: A small double-entry book: accounts, journals, trial balance and P&L.
logic: Chart of accounts with types (asset, liability, equity, income, expense). Journal entries requiring debits to equal credits before they post - reject unbalanced entries with a clear message. Account ledgers with running balances. Trial balance that must balance, shown with the difference if it does not. Profit and loss from income/expense accounts and a balance sheet from the rest. Period filter.
out: localStorage books; print/PDF reports; CSV and JSON export

title: Service Agreement Builder
fn: Assembles a plain-English services contract from your answers, ready for a lawyer to check.
logic: Guided questions produce clauses: parties, services described, deliverables and milestones, fees and payment schedule, expenses, term and renewal, termination for convenience and for cause with notice periods, IP ownership (client-owned, contractor-owned, or licensed), confidentiality, warranties, limitation of liability capped at fees paid, insurance, subcontracting, governing law and dispute resolution. Optional clauses toggled in and out; the document rebuilds live. Numbered clauses with automatic cross-references. Signature blocks. A clear, unmissable notice that this is a starting draft and not legal advice, and that a qualified lawyer in the relevant jurisdiction must review it before signing.
out: localStorage drafts; print/PDF; the disclaimer prints on the document

title: NDA Generator
fn: One-way or mutual non-disclosure agreements with the usual carve-outs.
logic: Choose one-way or mutual. Define confidential information, purpose of disclosure, term of the agreement and survival period for the obligation. Standard carve-outs: already public, independently developed, lawfully received from a third party, required by law to disclose. Return-or-destroy obligation. No-licence clause. Remedies including injunctive relief. Governing law. Signature blocks. Same unmissable not-legal-advice notice, printed on the document.
out: localStorage; print/PDF

title: Late Payment Chaser
fn: Escalating payment reminder letters with statutory interest calculated.
logic: Three escalation stages with appropriately firmer wording: polite reminder, formal notice, final demand before action. Days overdue computed from the due date. UK statutory interest: 8% plus Bank of England base rate, plus the fixed compensation of 40/70/100 GBP by debt size. US: contractual rate or state statutory rate entered manually. Interest accrues daily and is shown as a running figure. Merges invoice details into the letter.
out: localStorage debtor list; print/PDF letters; CSV

title: Rental Agreement Builder
fn: A residential or equipment rental agreement with schedule and condition record.
logic: Parties, property or equipment described, term (fixed or periodic), rent amount and frequency, payment method and date due, deposit amount and how it is protected, permitted use, maintenance responsibilities split between parties, insurance, subletting, access and notice rules, termination and notice periods, and an inventory/condition schedule with per-item condition ratings. Signature blocks. The not-legal-advice notice, plus a reminder that residential tenancies are heavily regulated and local law overrides anything here.
out: localStorage; print/PDF

title: Bill of Sale
fn: Transfers ownership of goods or a vehicle with warranties and an as-is option.
logic: Seller and buyer details, item description with serial/VIN/registration, sale price in figures and words, payment method and date, odometer statement for vehicles, and the choice between an express warranty of title or an explicit as-is/with-all-faults sale. Lien disclosure. Delivery date and place. Signature and witness blocks with dates. Notarisation block optional. The not-legal-advice notice.
out: localStorage; print/PDF

title: Subcontractor Agreement
fn: A construction or services subcontract with scope, payment and site obligations.
logic: Main contractor and subcontractor details, project reference, scope of works, programme dates, contract sum (fixed, rates, or cost-plus), payment terms and retention percentage with release dates, variation procedure, insurance requirements with minimum cover amounts, health and safety obligations, CIS/tax status, defects liability period, and termination. Payment schedule table computes retention and net amounts. The not-legal-advice notice.
out: localStorage; print/PDF; CSV of the payment schedule

title: Photo & Model Release
fn: Model or property releases for commercial image use, including minors.
logic: Subject details, photographer/company, shoot date and location, description of images. Scope of licence: media permitted, territory, duration (perpetual or fixed), and whether commercial and editorial use are both allowed. Exclusions the subject can specify. Compensation stated or explicitly none. Minor section with parent/guardian details and signature when the subject is under 18 - the form adapts to require it. Signature blocks.
out: localStorage; print/PDF

title: Employment Offer Letter
fn: A job offer letter with the key terms and an acceptance block.
logic: Candidate and employer details, job title, reporting line, start date, location and any hybrid arrangement, salary and pay frequency, bonus or commission structure, hours and overtime treatment, holiday entitlement, pension/401k, probation period and notice during and after it, benefits list, conditions of the offer (references, right to work, background check), and offer expiry date. Acceptance signature block. The not-legal-advice notice with a reminder that employment law is jurisdiction-specific.
out: localStorage; print/PDF

title: Shift Rota Planner
fn: Builds a weekly staff rota, totals hours and cost, and flags rule breaches.
logic: Grid of staff down, days across. Assign shifts by picking a shift template (name, start, end, break) or a custom time. Hours per shift computed including overnight shifts. Per-person weekly hours and cost from their rate; per-day headcount against a required-cover number with under-staffed days highlighted. Rule checks: minimum rest between shifts (default 11 hours), maximum consecutive days, weekly hours cap - each breach flagged on the cell with the reason. Copy last week forward.
out: localStorage rotas and staff list; print/PDF wall rota; CSV

title: Staff Holiday Tracker
fn: Annual leave entitlement, booked days, and who is off on any given day.
logic: Per employee: annual entitlement in days, carried over, booked and remaining computed. Bookings as date ranges excluding weekends and a configurable public holiday list. Year calendar grid showing each person's booked days. Clash detection - warns when more than N of a team are off on the same day. Pro-rata entitlement for mid-year starters computed from the start date. Approval status per request.
out: localStorage; print/PDF year chart; CSV

title: On-Call Rotation Planner
fn: Generates a fair on-call rota and shows who is on now.
logic: Round-robin allocation across a team over a chosen period, weekly or daily handover at a set time. Honours blackout dates per person (holiday, unavailable). Fairness report showing shifts per person, weekends per person, and holidays per person, so the split is visibly even. Current on-call and next handover shown prominently. Swap function that records who swapped with whom.
out: localStorage; print/PDF schedule; CSV; iCal-style text export

title: Appointment Booking Sheet
fn: A day book of appointments across staff or rooms with clash prevention.
logic: Day view with a column per resource (staff member, room, chair, bay) and time slots down. Book by clicking a slot, set duration and service. Overlapping bookings on one resource are refused with a clear message. Service durations configurable so a booking snaps to the right length. Buffer time between appointments. Day summary: utilisation percentage per resource, total booked value from service prices, gaps listed.
out: localStorage; print/PDF day sheet; CSV

title: Job Dispatch Board
fn: Assigns jobs to field engineers or drivers and tracks status through the day.
logic: Unassigned job pool and a column per operative. Drag or select to assign. Each job holds customer, address, time window, duration, priority and notes. Status progresses booked, dispatched, on-site, complete, failed - each stamped with a time. Per-operative load shown as total committed minutes against available minutes with an over-committed warning. End-of-day report: completed, failed with reasons, and jobs to carry over.
out: localStorage; print/PDF run sheets per operative; CSV

title: Timesheet Approval Board
fn: Manager view of submitted timesheets with exceptions surfaced for approval.
logic: List of employee timesheets by week with status (draft, submitted, approved, rejected, queried). Exceptions computed and shown as chips: over contracted hours, missing days, shifts under a minimum length, no break recorded on a long shift, overlapping entries. Approve or reject with a required comment on rejection. Bulk approve those with no exceptions. Totals for the pay run: hours, overtime, and cost by department.
out: localStorage; print/PDF approval report; CSV for payroll

title: Training & Certification Matrix
fn: Who holds which qualification, and what expires when.
logic: Grid of people against qualifications. Each cell holds an achieved date and, where the qualification expires, a validity period that computes the expiry. Cells colour by status: valid, expiring within a configurable window (default 60 days), expired, not held, not required. Per-role required qualifications so gaps show as red where it matters and grey where it does not. Renewals due list sorted by date. Compliance percentage per team and per qualification.
out: localStorage; print/PDF matrix; CSV

title: Meeting Cost Calculator
fn: What a meeting actually costs, live, while it runs.
logic: Attendees added with a role and hourly rate (or salary converted to hourly at a configurable working-hours-per-year). Live ticking cost while the meeting timer runs. Scheduled cost from planned duration versus actual cost when it overruns. Cost per agenda item if items are listed with allotted times. Annualised cost of a recurring meeting. A shareable summary line for the meeting notes.
out: localStorage meeting history; print/PDF summary; CSV

title: Vehicle Pre-Trip Inspection
fn: Driver vehicle inspection report covering every required check, with defect reporting.
logic: Standard DVIR check groups: brakes (service and parking), steering, lights and reflectors, tyres and wheels, horn, wipers, mirrors, coupling devices, emergency equipment, exhaust, fuel system, frame, suspension, cargo securement. Each item marked OK, defect or not applicable. A defect requires a description and a severity (out-of-service or minor) - out-of-service defects block the 'safe to operate' declaration until signed off by a mechanic. Odometer, unit number, trailer number, date/time, driver signature, and a mechanic sign-off block. Carries the previous report's unresolved defects forward.
out: localStorage report history; print/PDF DVIR; CSV

title: Toolbox Talk Record
fn: Records a site safety briefing and everyone who attended, with signatures.
logic: Topic (chosen from a built-in library of common talks with talking points, or free text), date, time, location, site, presenter. Hazards discussed and controls agreed as list items. Attendee register with printed name and signature line, added on screen or left blank to sign on paper. Questions raised and actions arising with owner and due date. Duration. Counts attendees and flags anyone on the site roster who did not attend.
out: localStorage talk history; print/PDF register; CSV

title: Risk Assessment Builder
fn: Hazard-by-hazard risk assessment with scored risk before and after controls.
logic: Per hazard: description, who might be harmed, existing controls, likelihood 1-5, severity 1-5, risk score = likelihood x severity, banded low 1-4, medium 5-9, high 10-16, extreme 17-25 with colour and a required action by band. Additional controls entered, then residual likelihood and severity give a residual score - the tool shows whether the control actually reduced the band. Assessor, date, review date, and the persons at risk. Extreme residual scores are flagged as not acceptable to proceed.
out: localStorage assessments; print/PDF; CSV

title: Incident & Near-Miss Report
fn: Captures an accident or near miss with enough detail for investigation and reporting.
logic: Type (injury, near miss, property damage, environmental, dangerous occurrence), date/time, exact location, people involved with roles, witnesses with contact details, description of what happened, injury details and body part, treatment given, and whether the person went to hospital. Immediate cause and root cause fields with a five-whys prompt. Actions with owner and due date. Reportability check that flags when an incident may meet RIDDOR or OSHA recordable criteria and tells the user to verify against the current regulations rather than relying on the tool. Sequential incident number.
out: localStorage register; print/PDF report; CSV

title: Fire Safety Equipment Log
fn: Register of extinguishers, alarms and emergency lighting with test schedules.
logic: Asset register: type, location, serial, install date, service interval. Test log per asset with date, tester, result and notes. Next-due date computed from the last test and the interval; overdue items listed first and flagged. Standard intervals pre-loaded: extinguisher monthly visual and annual service, alarm weekly call point test rotating through points, emergency lighting monthly function and annual three-hour drain. Weekly call-point rotation suggests which point to test this week.
out: localStorage; print/PDF logbook pages; CSV

title: Food Safety Temperature Log
fn: HACCP fridge, freezer and cooking temperature records with automatic breach flagging.
logic: Units registered with type and their safe range (fridge 0-5C/32-41F, freezer -18C or below, hot hold 63C+/145F+, cooking core 75C/165F). Readings logged with date, time, value and who took it - out-of-range readings flagged immediately with a required corrective action before the entry saves. Twice-daily prompts per unit. Cooking and cooling logs with the two-stage cooling rule (to 21C within 2 hours, to 5C within a further 4). Monthly summary with breach count per unit.
out: localStorage; print/PDF logbook; CSV

title: PPE Issue Register
fn: Who has been issued what protective equipment, when, and when it needs replacing.
logic: Per issue: employee, item type and size, quantity, issue date, signature line, and a replacement interval that computes the next-due date. Item catalogue with expected life. Outstanding items per employee. Returns recorded on leaving. Replacement due list. Cost tracking per employee and per department from item costs. Flags employees missing PPE that their role requires.
out: localStorage; print/PDF issue sheets; CSV

title: Forklift Daily Check
fn: Pre-use inspection for lift trucks with defect escalation.
logic: Check groups: forks and mast, chains and hoses, tyres, brakes, steering, horn, lights and beacon, seatbelt, hydraulics, battery or fuel, data plate legible, overhead guard, and load backrest. Each OK, defect, or not applicable. Any defect on a safety-critical item marks the truck NOT SAFE TO USE and requires a supervisor sign-off before clearing. Hour meter reading, truck ID, operator name and licence expiry - an expired licence blocks the check. Previous defects carried forward until cleared.
out: localStorage; print/PDF check sheets; CSV

title: First Aid Kit Audit
fn: Checks kit contents against a required list and flags shortfalls and expiry dates.
logic: Standard contents list per kit size (small, medium, large, travel, vehicle) pre-loaded with required quantities, editable. Audit records actual quantity found and expiry date per item. Shortfalls computed as required minus actual, listed as a restock order. Items expiring within a configurable window flagged. Kit location register with last-audit and next-due dates. Audit history per kit.
out: localStorage; print/PDF audit sheet and restock list; CSV

title: Chemical & COSHH Register
fn: Inventory of hazardous substances with hazard classes, controls and safety data sheet tracking.
logic: Per substance: product name, supplier, GHS hazard pictograms selected from the nine standard ones, hazard and precautionary statement codes, quantity held, storage location, and the date of the safety data sheet with an age warning past a configurable period. Required controls: ventilation, PPE (which items), storage segregation, spill procedure. Incompatible-storage warning when substances of conflicting classes share a location. Assessment review date per substance.
out: localStorage; print/PDF register and per-substance sheets; CSV

title: Job Costing & Margin Calculator
fn: True cost of a job across labour, materials, subcontract and overhead, with the margin it actually earns.
logic: Labour lines: hours x charge-out rate, with a separate true cost rate (wage plus on-costs percentage for tax, pension, holiday) so the margin is honest. Material lines with cost and markup. Subcontract lines. Plant and equipment. Overhead recovered either as a percentage of cost or a rate per labour hour. Quoted price against total cost gives gross margin, net margin and the markup applied. Break-even price shown. Warns when margin falls below a target percentage. Variance against the original estimate once actuals are entered.
out: localStorage jobs; print/PDF costing sheet; CSV

title: Break-Even Calculator
fn: The units and revenue needed to cover costs, with a margin-of-safety read.
logic: Contribution per unit = price - variable cost. Break-even units = fixed costs / contribution. Break-even revenue = units x price. Contribution margin ratio. Margin of safety = (actual or forecast sales - break-even) / sales. Target-profit units = (fixed + target profit) / contribution. Sensitivity table showing break-even at price and cost variations of plus and minus 5, 10 and 20 percent. Multi-product mode weights contribution by sales mix.
out: localStorage scenarios; print/PDF; CSV

title: Freelance Rate Calculator
fn: The hourly and day rate you must charge to hit a target income.
logic: Works backwards from desired take-home. Adds back tax and national insurance/self-employment tax at an entered rate, business costs (software, insurance, equipment, accountant, workspace), and pension. Available hours = weeks worked (52 minus holiday, sick and training weeks) x days per week x billable hours per day, reduced by a realistic utilisation percentage (default 70%) because admin and sales are unbilled. Required hourly = total needed / billable hours. Day and week rates derived. Shows the gap between what people assume and what utilisation actually does to the number.
out: localStorage; print/PDF summary; CSV

title: Loan Amortisation Schedule
fn: Full repayment schedule for a loan or finance agreement, with overpayment modelling.
logic: Monthly payment by the standard annuity formula P = r*PV / (1-(1+r)^-n) where r is the periodic rate. Schedule row per period: opening balance, payment, interest, principal, closing balance. Totals for interest paid and total repaid. Overpayment modelling: a regular monthly extra or a one-off lump sum, showing months saved and interest saved against the base case. Interest-only period option. Balloon payment option. Payment frequency monthly, fortnightly or weekly with the rate converted correctly.
out: localStorage; print/PDF schedule; CSV of the full table

title: Sales Tax & VAT Calculator
fn: Adds or removes tax at any rate, and builds a tax summary for a set of lines.
logic: Add tax: net x (1+rate). Remove tax: gross / (1+rate) - the calculation people most often get wrong, shown explicitly. Multiple rates in one document (standard, reduced, zero, exempt) each subtotalled separately as a tax return needs. Reverse charge and out-of-scope flags that exclude lines from the tax total but keep them in the document total. Rate presets for common jurisdictions, all editable. Line list with a tax summary table by rate showing net, tax and gross per rate.
out: localStorage; print/PDF tax summary; CSV

title: 13-Week Cash Flow Forecast
fn: Rolling weekly cash forecast showing exactly which week you run short.
logic: Thirteen week columns. Rows: opening balance, receipts by category, payments by category, net movement, closing balance which carries to the next week's opening. Recurring items repeat automatically at a set frequency. One-off items on a specific week. Any week closing below zero, or below a minimum-balance threshold, is flagged with the shortfall amount. Best and worst case by shifting receipts later by a configurable number of days. Actual-versus-forecast once actuals are entered for elapsed weeks.
out: localStorage forecasts; print/PDF; CSV

title: Markup & Margin Converter
fn: Converts between markup and margin and prices a product from either.
logic: Margin = (price - cost)/price. Markup = (price - cost)/cost. Price from cost and target margin = cost/(1-margin). Price from cost and markup = cost x (1+markup). Conversion table between the two shown side by side because they are constantly confused. Multi-tier pricing: cost, trade price, retail price each with their own margin. Discount impact: shows the extra volume needed to keep the same gross profit after a discount - the number that stops bad discounting.
out: localStorage price lists; print/PDF; CSV

title: Lease vs Buy Calculator
fn: Compares buying outright, financing, and leasing equipment on total cost.
logic: Buy: purchase price, less resale value at end of term, plus maintenance, plus the opportunity cost of the capital at an entered rate. Finance: deposit, monthly payment, term, balloon, plus maintenance, less resale. Lease: monthly payment, term, excess-use charges, maintenance included or not, no residual. All three brought to a total cost of ownership over the same term and a monthly equivalent. Net present value using a discount rate so the timing of payments is handled properly. Tax treatment note as a field rather than an assumption.
out: localStorage comparisons; print/PDF; CSV

title: Discount & Payment Terms Calculator
fn: What an early-payment discount really costs, as an annualised rate.
logic: Terms like 2/10 net 30 parsed into discount percent, discount days and net days. Effective annual rate = (discount/(100-discount)) x (365/(net days - discount days)). Shows whether taking the discount beats your cost of borrowing. From the seller's side: the annual cost of offering the discount against the cash brought forward. Days sales outstanding impact. A table of common terms with their true annualised cost so the comparison is immediate.
out: localStorage; print/PDF; CSV

title: Price List Builder
fn: Builds a customer-facing price list with tiers, breaks and currency conversion.
logic: Products with cost, and prices derived per tier (trade, retail, distributor) from tier margins. Quantity break pricing: bands with their own prices, checked so a larger quantity is never dearer. Currency conversion at an entered rate with a rounding rule (nearest .99, nearest whole, nearest 5). Effective-from date and version number. Bulk percentage increase applied to a whole category. Print output is a clean customer price list that hides cost and margin.
out: localStorage catalogues; print/PDF customer list; CSV

title: Menu Plate Cost & Engineering
fn: Costs a dish from its recipe and shows which menu items actually make money.
logic: Recipe lines: ingredient, purchase quantity and price, yield percentage after trim and waste - true cost per usable unit computed. Portion cost summed. Gross profit = selling price - cost; food cost percentage = cost/price. Target price from a desired food cost percentage. Menu engineering quadrant: each dish plotted by popularity (units sold) against contribution margin, classified Star, Plough Horse, Puzzle or Dog with the standard recommended action for each. VAT-inclusive and exclusive pricing.
out: localStorage recipe book; print/PDF costing cards; CSV

title: Recipe Cost & Batch Scaler
fn: Scales a recipe to any yield and recalculates cost per portion.
logic: Scale by target portions or by a scale factor; every quantity recalculated with sensible rounding and unit conversion (g/kg, ml/L, oz/lb, cups/tbsp/tsp). Baker's percentages mode where every ingredient is expressed against flour weight - the professional way to scale dough. Cost per batch and per portion. Allergen flags per ingredient rolled up to the dish. Method steps that scale times where relevant. Prep sheet output for the kitchen.
out: localStorage recipes; print/PDF prep sheet; CSV

title: Bar & Kitchen Stock Take
fn: Counts stock, values it, and calculates usage and variance against sales.
logic: Product list with unit, pack size and cost. Count entered as full units plus part-units (a bottle counted to tenths). Opening stock plus purchases minus closing stock gives usage. Expected usage from sales data entered per product; variance = actual minus expected, shown in units, cost and percentage - the number that finds theft and over-pouring. Stock value at cost. Days-of-cover from usage rate. Items below par flagged for ordering.
out: localStorage counts; print/PDF stock sheet and variance report; CSV

title: Table Reservation Book
fn: A restaurant booking diary with covers, turns and table allocation.
logic: Service periods (lunch, dinner) with seating times. Bookings hold name, contact, party size, time, table, notes and status (booked, confirmed, seated, no-show, cancelled). Tables with capacities; a booking cannot be assigned to a table too small. Turn time per party size with the table released afterwards. Covers per service and per slot against capacity, with a live remaining-covers figure. Walk-in space held back as a percentage. No-show rate tracked per guest.
out: localStorage diary; print/PDF service sheet; CSV

title: Digital Menu Board
fn: A full-screen menu display for a TV or tablet, edited in place and shown offline.
logic: Edit mode and display mode. Categories with items, descriptions, prices, and flags (vegan, gluten-free, spicy, new). Multi-panel layout that auto-fits the screen with legible type at distance - font scales to fill. Sold-out toggle greys an item out. Day-part switching shows the breakfast menu before a set time and lunch after, automatically. Rotating promo panel between menu pages. Fullscreen with the cursor hidden and no scrolling - it just runs.
out: localStorage menu; runs offline forever once loaded; JSON import/export of the menu

title: Tip Pooling Calculator
fn: Splits a tip pool fairly by hours, role weighting or points.
logic: Three methods: equal split, hours-weighted, and points-weighted where each role carries a multiplier (server 1.0, bartender 1.0, busser 0.5, kitchen 0.3 - all editable). Per person: hours worked x role weight = points; share = points/total points x pool. Card tips and cash tips handled separately with card processing fees optionally deducted before the split, shown explicitly. Rounding to the nearest note with the remainder handled transparently. Per-shift and per-week views.
out: localStorage; print/PDF distribution sheet; CSV

title: Inventory Par Level Sheet
fn: Sets par levels and produces the order from what is actually on the shelf.
logic: Per product: par level, current count, pack size, supplier, and lead time. Order quantity = par minus count, rounded up to whole packs. Grouped by supplier so each becomes a separate order. Usage rate from previous counts suggests whether the par is set right, flagging products that repeatedly run out or repeatedly overstock. Order value per supplier and total. Minimum-order-value warning per supplier.
out: localStorage; print/PDF orders per supplier; CSV

title: Food Waste Log
fn: Records waste with reason and cost so the biggest losses are visible.
logic: Per entry: date, product, quantity, unit cost, total value, reason (spoilage, over-production, prep error, customer return, spillage, out of date) and who recorded it. Daily and weekly totals by value. Ranked reasons and ranked products by cost so the worst offenders are obvious. Waste as a percentage of food cost or sales when those figures are entered. Trend over weeks. Target threshold with an alert when exceeded.
out: localStorage; print/PDF waste report; CSV

title: Allergen Matrix
fn: Dish-by-allergen grid built from recipes, printed for staff and customers.
logic: The 14 major allergens (cereals containing gluten, crustaceans, eggs, fish, peanuts, soybeans, milk, nuts, celery, mustard, sesame, sulphites, lupin, molluscs) as columns, dishes as rows. Marked contains, may contain (cross-contamination), or free from. Built up from an ingredient library so changing an ingredient updates every dish using it. Customer-facing print view and a kitchen view showing which ingredient causes each flag. A clear notice that the operator is responsible for verifying against supplier specifications.
out: localStorage ingredient and dish library; print/PDF both views; CSV

title: Daily Cash-Up Sheet
fn: End-of-day till reconciliation with denomination count and variance.
logic: Opening float. Denomination count for notes and coins, totalled. Card takings by terminal, cash takings, vouchers, account sales. Paid-outs recorded with reason. Expected cash = opening float + cash sales - paid-outs - banked. Variance = counted minus expected, flagged over a tolerance. Z-reading total entered and reconciled against the sum of tenders. Banking slip with the amount to bank and the float retained. Signed off by two people.
out: localStorage day history; print/PDF cash-up sheet and banking slip; CSV

title: Property Inventory Report
fn: Room-by-room condition schedule for a tenancy check-in or check-out.
logic: Rooms with items; each item has a description, condition (new, good, fair, poor, damaged), cleanliness rating and notes. Photo slots as data-URI uploads sized down on import so the file stays manageable. Check-in and check-out columns side by side on the same schedule, so changes are immediately visible with a difference flag. Meter readings and key counts. Tenant and agent signature blocks with dates. Deposit deduction candidates listed automatically from items that worsened.
out: localStorage properties; print/PDF full schedule; JSON export

title: Snagging & Defects List
fn: Records construction defects by location with priority, owner and sign-off.
logic: Per snag: reference number, location (room or area), trade responsible, description, priority (urgent, high, medium, low), raised date, target date, status (open, in progress, ready to inspect, closed, rejected), and photo. Grouped by trade so each contractor gets their own list, and by room for a walk-round. Overdue snags flagged. Completion percentage overall and per trade. Sign-off block per snag with inspector and date.
out: localStorage projects; print/PDF lists by trade or by room; CSV

title: Meter Reading Log
fn: Utility readings over time with consumption, cost and anomaly detection.
logic: Meters registered with type (electric, gas, water, heat), unit, and a conversion factor for gas (m3 to kWh via calorific value and correction factor 1.02264). Readings with date; consumption = this reading minus last. Cost from unit rate plus standing charge for the period. Daily average consumption. Anomaly flag when a period's daily average exceeds the trailing average by a configurable percentage - catches leaks and faults. Multi-property and multi-meter. Chart of consumption over time.
out: localStorage; print/PDF statement; CSV

title: Service Call Sheet
fn: Field engineer job sheet with time, parts, and customer signature.
logic: Customer and site details, job reference, fault reported and fault found, work carried out, time on and off site with travel time separate, parts used with quantity and price, labour at a rate with a minimum charge and out-of-hours multiplier. Total computed. Follow-up required flag with reason and parts to order. Customer signature block confirming the work. Safety checks completed tick-list. Next service due date.
out: localStorage job history; print/PDF job sheet; CSV

title: Asset Register with QR Labels
fn: Fixed asset register that prints scannable QR labels for each item.
logic: Per asset: tag number, description, category, location, serial, supplier, purchase date, cost, expected life, and depreciation method (straight line or reducing balance) with current net book value computed from the elapsed time. Condition and last-inspected date. QR code generated in pure JavaScript encoding the asset tag and a lookup reference - printed as a sheet of labels at a standard label pitch. Disposal recording with date and proceeds, and gain or loss on disposal.
out: localStorage register; print/PDF label sheets and the register; CSV

title: Planned Maintenance Schedule
fn: Recurring maintenance tasks with next-due dates and a workload view.
logic: Tasks per asset with a frequency (daily, weekly, monthly, quarterly, biannual, annual, or every N days) and an estimated duration. Next due computed from the last completed date. Overdue listed first with days overdue. Calendar view by month showing the workload in hours per week so peaks are visible before they arrive. Completion recording that rolls the next due date forward. Compliance percentage: tasks done on time against total due.
out: localStorage; print/PDF work orders and schedule; CSV

title: Key & Access Register
fn: Tracks who holds which key or access card, and what is outstanding.
logic: Key register with key number, description, door or area, and how many copies exist. Issue records: holder, issue date, expected return, signature line, and deposit taken. Outstanding keys listed by holder with days held. Return recording with condition and deposit refunded. Lost key procedure flag that lists every door affected and whether a lock change is needed. Audit view showing all copies of a key and who holds each.
out: localStorage; print/PDF issue receipts and audit; CSV

title: Tenancy Deposit Deduction Calculator
fn: Builds a fair, evidenced deposit deduction schedule with betterment applied.
logic: Per proposed deduction: item, the check-in condition against check-out condition, cost of repair or replacement quoted, the item's expected life and its age, and therefore the apportioned amount after fair wear and tear - replacement cost x remaining life / expected life. Cleaning and rent arrears as separate lines. Total proposed against the deposit held, showing the balance returnable. Evidence checklist per line (inventory reference, photo, invoice). A clear notice that deposit schemes adjudicate on evidence and betterment, and that full replacement cost for a part-worn item is routinely rejected.
out: localStorage; print/PDF deduction schedule; CSV

title: Wedding Budget & Guest List
fn: Wedding budget against actuals, plus guest list, RSVPs and table plan.
logic: Budget by category with estimated, quoted, deposit paid and final cost - variance and remaining budget computed live. Payment schedule with due dates and an alert for what is due next. Guest list with side, group, invitation sent, RSVP status, meal choice, dietary needs and plus-ones. Head count drives the per-head catering cost automatically. Table plan: tables with capacities, guests assigned, over-capacity prevented. Countdown to the date with a task checklist by timeframe.
out: localStorage; print/PDF budget, guest list, place cards and table plan; CSV

title: Home Renovation Budget Tracker
fn: Room-by-room renovation budget with contingency and payment tracking.
logic: Per room, per trade: budget, quoted, actual, and variance. Contingency percentage held separately and drawn down explicitly so overspend is visible rather than hidden. Payment schedule with stage payments and retention. Running total against the overall budget with a percentage-complete estimate. Cost per room summary. Materials versus labour split. Alerts when a category exceeds budget by a configurable threshold.
out: localStorage projects; print/PDF budget report; CSV

title: Meal Planner & Shopping List
fn: A week of meals that generates a consolidated, aisle-sorted shopping list.
logic: Recipe library with ingredients, quantities and servings. Week grid of breakfast, lunch and dinner. Recipes scale to the household size automatically. Shopping list aggregates every ingredient across the week, combining duplicates with unit conversion (500g + 0.5kg = 1kg) and sorting by supermarket aisle category. Pantry staples excluded if marked as already held. Estimated cost from ingredient prices. Leftovers carried to another day.
out: localStorage recipes and plans; print/PDF plan and shopping list; CSV

title: Baby Feed & Sleep Log
fn: Feeds, nappies and sleep logged fast, with patterns over the day.
logic: One-tap logging with the time defaulting to now. Feeds: breast (side and duration) or bottle (volume), solids. Nappies: wet, dirty, both. Sleep: start and end giving duration. Daily totals: feed count, total volume, sleep hours, nappy counts. Timeline view of the day as a strip so patterns are visible. Time since last feed shown prominently. Notes and temperature. Multi-child. Explicitly a record-keeping tool, with a notice that it gives no medical guidance and that concerns go to a health professional.
out: localStorage; print/PDF daily and weekly summaries for appointments; CSV

title: Medication Schedule & Log
fn: A personal medicine timetable and a record of doses actually taken.
logic: Medicines with name, strength, form, prescribed dose, frequency and times of day, start and end dates, and prescriber. Daily schedule generated from those times. Log a dose as taken, skipped or delayed with the actual time. Adherence percentage over a period. Refill tracking: quantity dispensed less doses taken gives days remaining and a reorder date. Printable schedule for carers or hospital admission. A clear, prominent notice that this records what a prescriber has already instructed, gives no dosing advice whatsoever, and must never be used to change a dose.
out: localStorage; print/PDF schedule and adherence record; CSV

title: Workout & Progression Log
fn: Logs training sessions and tracks strength progression per exercise.
logic: Sessions with date and routine. Per exercise: sets of weight and reps, with volume (weight x reps) totalled per exercise and session. Estimated one-rep max via the Epley formula weight x (1 + reps/30). Personal best per exercise highlighted when beaten. Progression chart per exercise over time. Rest timer between sets. Routine templates that pre-fill a session. Bodyweight and measurements tracked alongside.
out: localStorage history; print/PDF training log; CSV

title: Debt Payoff Planner
fn: Compares snowball and avalanche payoff strategies with a month-by-month plan.
logic: Debts with balance, APR and minimum payment. Snowball orders by smallest balance, avalanche by highest APR. Monthly simulation: minimums paid on all, the extra payment plus freed-up minimums rolled onto the target debt. Produces the payoff date and total interest for each strategy side by side, showing exactly what the avalanche saves and how much sooner the snowball clears the first debt. Month-by-month schedule per debt. What-if slider on the extra monthly amount.
out: localStorage; print/PDF payoff plan; CSV

title: Habit Tracker
fn: A year of habits as a grid, with streaks and completion rates.
logic: Habits with a target frequency (daily, or N times a week). Year grid of days per habit, marked complete with a click. Current streak and longest streak computed, where a weekly-target habit does not break its streak on an off day. Completion percentage per habit per month and for the year. Monthly heat view. Notes per day. Archive a habit without losing its history.
out: localStorage; print/PDF year chart; CSV and JSON

title: Study & Revision Planner
fn: Builds a revision timetable working back from exam dates, weighted by confidence.
logic: Subjects with topics, each rated for confidence and importance. Exam dates entered; the planner works back and allocates study sessions across the available days, giving more sessions to low-confidence high-importance topics. Spaced repetition: each topic revisited at expanding intervals of 1, 3, 7, 14 and 30 days. Daily plan with session lengths and breaks. Progress marked per session; confidence updated afterwards, which re-weights the remaining plan. Days-to-exam countdown per subject.
out: localStorage; print/PDF timetable; CSV

title: Moving House Planner
fn: Timed moving checklist, box inventory and address-change tracker.
logic: Task checklist grouped by timeframe (8 weeks before, 4, 2, 1 week, moving day, after) with completion tracking and a countdown to the date. Box inventory: number, room, contents summary, fragile flag - printable numbered labels that match the inventory so unpacking is searchable. Address-change list of the usual organisations (bank, insurance, DVLA/DMV, GP, employer, utilities, subscriptions) each marked notified with the date. Utility readings at both properties. Moving-day essentials box list.
out: localStorage; print/PDF checklist and box labels; CSV
